capture_method: Business logos come from BBB search result cards (m.bbb.org ProfileImages or Google ad-creative hosts observed on the page); profile photos come from the business profile pages; news article images come from the BBB newsroom list payload; the homepage hero video and poster come from m.bbb.org terminus content. All captured on 2026-09-21 with a real Chromium browser and direct asset URLs observed on the rendered pages.
notes: Every logo belongs to the BBB business whose search card displayed it; file names carry the BBB business id so the seed can map logos 1:1.
Google-syndication ad-creative logos are the images actually served on BBB search result pages for the sponsored cards.
